name: Millweir sluice walk
notes: The Millweir in the scene briar-glen-river (mw-e25.12). The sluice wheel opens the drain of the mill pond (the pond falls to its dry bed and can be walked across); turning it back shuts the drain and opens the head sluice (a fill key on the pond), so the pond rises again to a deep pond that must be swum. The far-bank volume is the Briarwood far bank: the first time the player stands on it, by the walk, the stones or the water, the latch writes world.millweir.sluice-walk-open = true and keeps it, so the world map's shortcut stays open for good.
